lesson.subtitle: Lesson 7 -- The Plan
lesson.title_tag: Professor View -- Renato | Lesson 7 -- The Plan

listenings.text: Hi Renato, this is the arrival briefing, so listen once and then relax. When you land, somebody from the programme is going to meet you right after you collect your luggage. You are going to see a blue folder with your name on it, so look for that, not for a face. Before we take you to the house we are going to stop at the school, because you need your timetable and your student card on day one. It takes twenty minutes. Then home. One piece of advice and it is the most important thing I am going to say: do not sleep in the afternoon. Stay awake until nine at night. If you sleep at four, the jet lag is going to follow you for a week.

Alright, so you asked what I would do differently. Three things. First, the first two weeks are hard for everybody. Everybody gets homesick, and nobody says it out loud, and then it passes. That is normal, so do not panic. Second, do not call home every day. I did that for a month and I was never really there. Once a week is enough. Third, and this is the big one: sign up for anything with a team, even a sport you are terrible at. That is where the friends are. I signed up for water polo and I was awful, and those are still my mates.

items.situation: Somebody asks what you are going to do when you land. Answer in three sentences.
A friend asks how you are going to meet people there. Explain your plan.
Your mum asks what you are going to do if you get homesick. Answer honestly.
Look out of the window and make one prediction you can actually see coming.
Somebody asks about your luggage and your budget. Answer in two sentences.
